newsitem.title: USA: Armstrong sues to block Sommer/Domco deal.
newsitem.headline: Armstrong sues to block Sommer/Domco deal.

text.p: Armstrong World Industries Inc said Monday it has filed a 10-count complaint in a U.S. District Court against Sommer Allibert SA to prevent its from merging its floor covering business, including Domco Inc, with Tarkett AG.
Earlier today, Armstrong said it would offer C$23 per share cash to purchase all of the outstanding shares of Domco. The total value of the transaction would be $C488 million, US$354 million.

In its complaint, Armstrong said it wants a preliminary and permanent injunction to keep Sommer Allibert from merging its floor covering business, including Domco, with Tarkett, which competes with Armstrong in the floor covering business. That proposed merger was announced on May 28.
Armstrong said it is also seeking compensatory and punitive damages.
Armstrong is a global manufacturer and marketer of interior furnishings, including floor coverings and ceiling systems, with sales of $2.156 billion in 1996.
